content.title: Open the concentration warning popover
content.intent: Prove the interactive warning reveals the anchored popover with the concentration details and recommended action.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to separate the interactive disclosure path from passive dashboard review. Applied state/flow because the scenario changes from warning-visible to popover-open. No covering array was needed because the source defined a single interaction path rather than multiple independent inputs; risk-judged combinatorial strength remained 2 (no money, auth, or data-loss factors applied to the grounded behavior).
